subject: Request for information: inflatable advertising device thermal events
body:
To Grand Inflation Industries,

The Commission has received consumer and worker reports describing thermal shutdown events in inflatable advertising devices (tube men) at automotive dealerships in Ohio, Michigan, and Indiana.

Within five business days, please provide: (1) the number of affected units and your basis for that estimate, (2) the component or lot implicated, if identified, (3) any corrective action initiated or planned, and (4) your assessment of fire or burn hazard to consumers or workers.

We note for the record that a timely, well-scoped voluntary corrective action is viewed favorably.

Office of Compliance and Field Operations
U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission
